messages.content: i have put my book away, and now i am making tea.
you put the book away, and now you are making tea.
have i finished making the tea too?
you did not say that. you said you are making it now.
i just finished. what can i say?
i have put my book away and made my tea.
i have visited that little town before.
what do you remember about it?
a quiet street and a garden near the school.
you remember a quiet street and a garden near the school from your visit.
do you know what year i went?
no. you have not said the year.
the kitchen was being cleaned when i came home. was the cleaning already done?
no. was being cleaned says the cleaning was happening then.
now write it as finished before i came home.
the kitchen had been cleaned before i came home.
did the order change?
yes. now the cleaning was done before you came home.
i will be reading in the garden after lunch. my sister can join me there.
you can tell her you will be in the garden after lunch.
can you write that with reading in it?
i will be reading in the garden after lunch. you can join me there.
where should she look for me?
in the garden.
she gave her brother a book. who got the book?
her brother.
did she get it from him in that sentence?
no. she gave it to him.
now make the sentence about a pen instead.
she gave her brother a pen.
the man who came with my aunt is waiting outside. who is waiting?
the man who came with your aunt.
do you know his name?
no. you have not said his name.
just tell me where he is waiting.
outside.
ask my friend if she has finished the book.
have you finished the book?
add already. i did not know she read so much.
have you already finished the book?
does the question say she has finished for sure?
no. it asks if she has.
write please put the cup on the table.
please put the cup on the table.
is the cup on the table now because you wrote that?
no. it asks someone to do it. it does not say someone did it.
now make it a question.
could you please put the cup on the table?
i want to go out, but i have work to finish.
you want to go out, but the work is not finished.
can you write a short note to my friend saying that?
i want to come out, but i have work to finish.
do not say i do not want to see her.
i want to come out, but i have work to finish.
my shoes have water in them, so i want to put on other shoes. write it with so.
my shoes have water in them, so i will put on other shoes.
do not say the other shoes are new.
my shoes have water in them, so i will put on other shoes.
what is the reason for changing shoes?
your shoes have water in them.
write that i will have cleaned my room before my sister comes.
i will have cleaned my room before my sister comes.
does that say it is clean right now?
no. it says the cleaning will be done before she comes.
now use my kitchen instead of my room.
i will have cleaned my kitchen before my sister comes.
write a story sentence with had built and a little house.
the children had built a little house before the rain came.
what was already done before the rain?
the children had built the little house.
does that tell you the house color?
no. the sentence does not give a color.
ask my cousin if he walks to school every day.
do you walk to school every day?
now ask if he walked yesterday.
did you walk to school yesterday?
which question is about one day?
did you walk to school yesterday?
write i went to the shop with did not.
i did not go to the shop.
why not did not went?
after did not, we use go in this sentence.
now change shop to school.
i did not go to school.
i have four books and my brother has two. say it with more and than.
i have more books than my brother.
can you give the number too?
i have two more books than my brother.
who has two books?
your brother.
my sister and i have a garden together. use our in a sentence.
our garden is near the house.
do you know if it is really near a house?
no. that was an example sentence. you only said you have a garden together.
just write a sentence with what i said.
my sister and i have our own garden.
write that my parents left their bag in the car.
my parents left their bag in the car.
is their bag my bag in that sentence?
no. their is about your parents here.
now just tell me the place.
in the car.
i went inside because i was cold. put because first.
because i was cold, i went inside.
did the reason change?
no. being cold is still the reason you went inside.
just write the first sentence again.
i went inside because i was cold.
my sister said she had found my hat.
did she say where she found it?
under the bed.
your sister said she found your hat under the bed.
who found it, from what she said?
your sister.
use had been working in a sentence about a tired man.
the man had been working all day and felt tired.
now make it about a woman.
the woman had been working all day and felt tired.
did that say she had a rest all day?
no. it says she had been working.
if i finish my reading before lunch, can i go to the park after lunch? i have no other work.
you could make that your plan.
just help me say the plan in one sentence.
if i finish my reading before lunch, i will go to the park after lunch.
did you keep if?
yes.
ask about having tea with my grandmother. use why not.
why not have tea with your grandmother?
now say it to her from me.
why not have tea together?
is that an order?
no. you are asking about an idea.
ask my friend if she would like water or juice.
would you like water or juice?
can you make it only about water?
would you like water?
did you still ask about water and juice?
no. the new question only asks about water.
i often read in the evening. does that mean every evening?
no. often does not have to mean every evening.
i did not read yesterday evening.
you can often read in the evening and still not read every evening.
just what i said i often do.
read in the evening.
is each child has a book right?
yes. each child has a book is right.
now use all the children.
all the children have a book.
which word changed from has?
have.
ask if my mother is reading.
is my mother reading?
now ask if she was reading yesterday.
was my mother reading yesterday?
did you change who the question is about?
no. it is still about your mother.
write that i will not cook today, but i will cook tomorrow.
i will not cook today, but i will cook tomorrow.
does that mean i never cook?
no. it says you will cook tomorrow.
now make it about cleaning instead.
i will not clean today, but i will clean tomorrow.
write about my brother washing a cup and then how he put it away.
my brother washed the cup and put it away.
did two people do the work in that sentence?
no. your brother did both things.
just the last thing he did.
he put the cup away.
ask my sister in a kind way not to move my book.
please do not move my book.
now say bag instead of book.
please do not move my bag.
did you keep do not?
yes.
use where in a sentence about the place i read.
this is the place where i read.
can you add in the morning?
this is the place where i read in the morning.
do you know the name of that place?
no. you have not said what place it is.
